title: The Invisible Audience
excerpt: There is a question many of us have heard since childhood: What will people say? In many Asian societies, this fear operates on a much stronger, formalized system governed by deep cultural and social expectations. It sounds harmless…

title: Faith or Fear??
excerpt: Somewhere along the way, many of us learned to imagine God as a cosmic supervisor. A heavenly report card holder. A divine CCTV camera is tracking our every move. And so we became careful.

title: People are portals.
excerpt: Spend enough time with a chronic complainer and suddenly life begins to look unfair. Spend enough time with an anxious person and danger seems to lurk around every corner. Spend enough time with an optimist and possibilities appear…

title: When you feel too much.
excerpt: I’ve heard this very often …don’t be so sensitive and I have spent a long time trying to understand what that actually means. Not to fix it, I’ve given up on that project. Just to understand it well enough to not be completely flattened…

title: Sometimes We Don’t Meet People. We Recognise Them!!
excerpt: The introduction happens. Words are exchanged. Context is established. Yet beneath all of it, something older moves first.

title: Let it bee!!
excerpt: There are times when I can feel a familiar pattern beginning to form. Thoughts start circling a situation. Anxiety quietly makes its presence known.

title: Living With an Unmet Inner Child
excerpt: This morning began quietly, but my mind was unusually alert. Not anxious. Just observant. Somewhere in that stillness, a realization surfaced: a deep, unmet need to be witnessed. Not as the adult I am today, but as the child I once was.

title: What I Didn’t Expect to Learn While Healing Others
excerpt: What I didn’t expect, when I began working as a healer, was how much I would learn about boundaries.

title: Three Pages, Every Morning
excerpt: I was introduced to morning pages in 2020.At the time, I didn’t realise how profoundly this simple practice would change my life.

title: Three Minutes of Gratitude
excerpt: Over the years, I’ve tried many ways to practice gratitude.Always through writing.
